'''Aleia Tanner''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] resident of [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]] born in [[13 BBY/Legends|13 BBY]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the fourteen-year old, the president of the [[Fitz Fan Club of Amander Public School|Fitz Fan Club]] of [[Amander Public School]], presented a [[Holocrystal/Legends|holocrystal]] to [[Fitz Roi]] at [[Curamel Intergalactic Spaceport|Calamar Spaceport]].
